fusions.name: Light Fingers
fusions.desc: Darts in at one enemy up to 5 tiles away and deals 7 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach, with a 40% chance to leave it [Weakened] for 6 seconds. Holds 4 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Between Their Legs
fusions.desc: Your swarm runs between the legs of every enemy within 3 tiles and deals 10 damage, with a 40% chance to turn each against its neighbours for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Not Mine, Yours
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever cast it instead.

fusions.name: Short-Changed
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
